data.description: Crevice Cube is a set of cube-shaped seats, each sitting on a black steel base, with tops in blue, yellow, teal and red. The blocks can be spaced out in a row or a cluster as informal seating. Children like to hop between them, and adults can sit on them. They suit school courtyards, society gardens, mall forecourts and the edges of a play area. Crevice Cube belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range. The listing gives the colour as Sand Beige, though the photos show coloured tops, so tell us which finish you want. We confirm the block size, the number of blocks in a set and the warranty in the quote.

items.pText: Crevice Cube is a set of cube-shaped seats, each sitting on a black steel base, with tops in blue, yellow, teal and red. The blocks can be spaced out in a row or a cluster as informal seating. Children like to hop between them, and adults can sit on them. They suit school courtyards, society gardens, mall forecourts and the edges of a play area. Crevice Cube belongs to our CoreCraft garden decor range. The listing gives the colour as Sand Beige, though the photos show coloured tops, so tell us which finish you want. We confirm the block size, the number of blocks in a set and the warranty in the quote.

Each Crevice Cube block stands on its own steel base, fixed self-standing or grouted so it cannot be moved. Space the blocks so there is a clear walking gap between them. Check the base fixings during maintenance and wipe the tops after rain.
